exposure: Multiple daily dosing (MDD) of intravenous amikacin
outcome: Nephrotoxicity (plasma creatinine, urine neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin (NGAL))
cohort: The study included 40 premature infants suspected of sepsis.
finding: No significant difference was observed in the efficacy and nephrotoxicity between once-daily and multiple-daily amikacin dosing regimens in premature infants suspected of sepsis, despite once-daily dosing showing a significantly higher reduction in mean plasma creatinine and mean serum amikacin levels.
